snippet.title: Tumor Necrosis Factor: aMEN Trailer (Demo, Steam)
snippet.description:
Steam trailer for ᴛᴜᴍᴏʀ ɴᴇᴄʀᴏꜱɪꜱ ꜰᴀᴄᴛᴏʀ:// αᴍᴇɴ, a surrealist light gun shooter inspired by Vampire Night and Shin Megami Tensei III: Nocturne.

🪱🪱🪱
Tear through the decaying Earth as a mutant half-worm in this arcade inspired rail shooter! Branching paths, fast-paced gameplay, and lots of gore: this grotesque mass is a blood smeared love letter to the classics of old.
🪱🪱🪱

Website: https://chicken-hat.neocities.org/TNFa/tnfgame
Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4353960/
But also on itch.io: https://chickenhat.itch.io/tumor-necrosis-factor-amen
My bsky is here: https://bsky.app/profile/chickenhat.bsky.social

Music by vivi: https://6pmspeakeasy.bandcamp.com/
